def redshape():
    a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    R=[(r,c) for r in range(23,35) for c in range(7,23) if a[r][c]=='R']
    if not R: return "none"
    rs=[r for r,c in R]; cs=[c for r,c in R]
    return "R%d-%d/%d-%d"%(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
def blueshape():
    a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    top=[(r,c) for r in range(19,25) for c in range(17,23) if a[r][c] in 'bc']
    low=[(r,c) for r in range(33,39) for c in range(7,13) if a[r][c] in 'bc']
    def pat(cells):
        if not cells: return "none"
        r0=min(r for r,c in cells); c0=min(c for r,c in cells)
        s=""
        for dr in range(4):
            for dc in range(4):
                s+= 'b' if (r0+dr,c0+dc) in set(cells) else ('c' if (r0+dr,c0+dc) in set(cells) else '.')
        return s
    # simpler: report counts of b and c in each region
    tb=sum(1 for r,c in top if a[r][c]=='b'); tc=sum(1 for r,c in top if a[r][c]=='c')
    lb=sum(1 for r,c in low if a[r][c]=='b'); lc=sum(1 for r,c in low if a[r][c]=='c')
    return "top(b%d,c%d) low(b%d,c%d)"%(tb,tc,lb,lc)
def corepos():
    a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    ns=[(r,c) for r in range(37,45) for c in range(7,15) if a[r][c]=='N']
    return (min(r for r,c in ns),min(c for r,c in ns)) if ns else None
